Commentary is one of the most important pillars of X. And sometimes the best way to share your thoughts is with video.

Today we're launching a whole new way to make them:
React with Video

Tap the repost button and start recording with green screen, split screen, or picture-in-picture. 

Now available on iOS

R to @nikitabier: Credit to the team that made it happen
@alxkikalia @i_aliullov @nicoduc @allegrajacchia  @z49547 @striedinger @geruk

We're testing two new ways to share posts from X to Instagram & Snapchat Stories

1. Share videos
R to @nikitabier: 2. Share a post with a reply—for those moments when you want to show off an incredible ratio
R to @nikitabier: Credit to @_trevorholliday for working on this side project — plus design from @nicoduc & @alexabraham. Early preview now on iPhone.

Every morning, the moment my eyes open, I wake up to 40 unread Slack messages that effectively say:

“If you don’t fix this in the next 5 minutes, the world will implode and the app will cease to exist.”
Reports of our death were greatly exaggerated.

Some of the most impactful work we do at X is invisible to the user. 

In the last 12 months, we have rewritten almost every core part of the app. 

We will soon be shipping a 90% reduction in our web app’s load times.
The best growth hacks are loops where the product experience naturally invites the next user. If you force a share button, it fails.
